description: Use when someone asks how to prepare for heat and weather safety, cold, altitude, lightning, flash floods, wildfire smoke, UV, wildlife/bears, ticks, hiking preparation or preparedness training. Returns official guidance links (CDC, NWS, NPS, EPA, OSHA, Red Cross), when to call 911, and how the GOES app's offline how-to guides help when there is no signal. Pointers only.
